text:
maria: Quick proposal — move the scope-swap out of the right rail chip and into the main header toolbar so it’s tabbable in compact mode. Found in usability testing that keyboard users can’t reach the chip reliably. Also: make the invoice download a persistent header action when viewing org scope so customers don’t have to open the ledger to get PDFs. alex: can you drop a mock? worried about header density. header is already pretty busy. maria: mock here: https://figma.redwood/proj/spend/header-scope-swap (comments on page 3). The idea: compact toolbar with icon+label that collapses to icon only <480px. Keep the header height the same. nina: +1 to moving it for accessibility. A couple of a11y things to add: role="tablist" isn’t ideal — prefer a toggle button with aria-pressed and aria-controls. Also, when scope changes we should announce the new total to screen readers (aria-live=polite on the total container). maria: noted. example snippet: and aria-live on total:
$12,345
sam: implementation note: header is shared across many routes. If we add a network call to resolve the latest invoice for the scope on header render, that could regress load. Suggest: render a download icon that calls the existing /invoices endpoint only on click. No extra fetch on page load. Also we should gate the persistent CTA behind a feature flag for Dedicated customers who expect it. maria: agreed. plan: icon-only button that hits /invoices?scope=org&format=pdf on click. fallback: disabled button with tooltip if user has no invoices. liz: product concern — discoverability for token breakdown: in compact mode the token card is buried below the fold. What if we add a small token chip in the header next to scope that opens a right drawer showing the token breakdown and copy-to-clipboard for token counts? ben: design nit — microcopy for the invoice button should be explicit. change from "Download invoice" to "Download PDF invoice" (users expect file type). Also the token badge label should say "Tokens (est.)" when counts are estimated due to caching. nina: color/contrast check: current token badge bg (#d9e8ff) fails AA on the text in dark mode. Proposed dark-mode bg: #1F2630 and white text, or bump text weight to semibold. Also ensure focus ring is visible: :focus { outline: 3px solid #0A84FF; outline-offset: 2px; } alex: small UX question — when toggling scope, should we persist the last scope per user? e.g., if you switch to project and later return to console, do we keep it? That affects metrics and invoices surfaced. maria: I think persist in localStorage + server-side preference for logged-in users (opt-in). For now, we’ll persist client-side only. Add a subtle snackbar: "Default scope saved" with undo. sam: will prototype keyboard order and aria attributes. I’ll avoid header-render fetches and wire the click handler to open the invoice file. ETA: PR by EOD Thursday, ready for design review Friday. maria: checklist for PR review: 1) header toolbar mock implemented 2) aria-pressed + aria-live added 3) invoice button calls /invoices on click (no prefetch) 4) token drawer toggle and compact collapse 5) copy text updated to "Download PDF invoice" and token label "Tokens (est.)" 6) dark-mode contrast fixes and visible focus ring. liz: +1 to checklist. Can we do a quick dark-mode QA pass before merging? ben: will run contrast checks and post adjustments to the figma file. nina: I’ll run a short screen-reader pass on the branch once it’s up. Thanks — this will fix the biggest keyboard-nav pain point we saw in testing. :raised_hands: sam: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/web/pull/4988 (includes keyboard order and aria markup). Leaving notes in the PR for feature flag gating. deploy-bot: Deployed preview https://staging.redwood-inference/spend-header-173850 to staging. maria: great — I’ll review on staging tomorrow morning. Thanks all! :heart:
